# Templates API endpoints
{: .no_toc}

Templates prefill a new record of their kind: a procedure template carries the type, the type-specific fields and the material rows a lab repeats, and applying it copies them into a new procedure. Each template resource mirrors the record it is for and is shared through its projects.

| Resource | App | What it is |
|:---------|:----|:-----------|
| [`proceduretemplate`](/api/modules/proceduretemplate/) | Modules | A reusable template that prefills a new procedure |
| [`procedureepisodetemplate`](/api/modules/procedureepisodetemplate/) | Modules | A reusable template that prefills a new procedure episode |
| [`specimenproceduretemplate`](/api/modules/specimenproceduretemplate/) | Modules | A reusable template that prefills a new specimen procedure |
| [`experimentalinterfacetemplate`](/api/modules/experimentalinterfacetemplate/) | Modules | A reusable template that prefills a new experimental interface |
| [`materialusagetemplate`](/api/modules/materialusagetemplate/) | Modules | A reusable template that prefills a new material usage |
| [`dataacquisitiontemplate`](/api/modules/dataacquisitiontemplate/) | Modules | A reusable template that prefills a new data acquisition |
| [`manipulationtemplate`](/api/modules/manipulationtemplate/) | Modules | A reusable template that prefills a new manipulation |
{% endraw %}
